same_research_goal: For a structure deduplication check, inventory all registered structures with the same basic connectivity as quinine. Return each qualifying registered compound ID and how completely its carbon stereochemistry is specified.

predicates.cg_quote: Use release 37, issued in May 2026, of the public database of curated small-molecule bioactivity measurements. Inventory that release’s registered compound records, with reference observations on 13 September 2026 (UTC).
predicates.go_quote: Use release 37, issued in May 2026, of the public database of curated small-molecule bioactivity measurements. Inventory that release’s registered compound records, with reference observations on 13 September 2026 (UTC).

predicates.cg_quote: Include only complete registered structures with exactly one covalently connected component and both a Standard InChI and canonical SMILES. Exclude multicomponent salts, hydrates and mixtures; do not strip components to make them qualify.

predicates.cg_quote: Here, the same basic connectivity means matching quinine’s Standard InChI formula, atom-connectivity (/c), hydrogen (/h), charge (/q) and protonation (/p) layers. Treat an absent layer as empty. Ignore stereochemical and isotope layers for this match.

predicates.cg_quote:
Classify the four tetrahedral carbon stereocentres of the quinine skeleton from the registered Standard InChI’s non-isotopic /t layer. A + or - assignment counts as specified; ? or a missing assignment counts as unspecified. If /t is absent from an otherwise complete Standard InChI, none of these centres is specified.

Use FULL for 4 specified centres, PARTIAL for 1–3, and UNSPECIFIED for 0. Count only these carbon centres, excluding nitrogen stereo marks.

guidance_difference.cg_quote:
To build the inventory:
1. Find quinine’s registered Standard InChI and InChIKey.
2. Use the discovered InChIKey’s first block in the structure-key prefix filter (standard_inchi_key__startswith), and retrieve every result page.
3. Check the actual structure layers and component count against the scope below, then assign the status.
guidance_difference.go_quote: For a structure deduplication check, inventory all registered structures with the same basic connectivity as quinine. Return each qualifying registered compound ID and how completely its carbon stereochemistry is specified.
guidance_difference.assessment: CG names three research operations; GO states the objective and all eligibility rules but leaves the retrieval route and order to the solver.
